candidate.name: Baker Effective Height Bound on Exponents for Fixed Bases
candidate.text: Candidate: Baker linear forms in logarithms applied to covering curves forces an effective upper bound on exponents max(x, y, z) <= B(A, B, C) for any fixed coprime bases.

legend.0: level 0: mathematically obstructed or known false
legend.1: level 1: requires open grand conjectures (e.g. general Langlands, Fontaine-Mazur)
legend.2: level 2: provable by combining proved theorems (Baker, Darmon, Khare-Wintenberger)
legend.3: level 3: complete machine-checkable proof in Lean 4
